item.title: Bulls use 27-0 run to beat Bucks 120-97 and win first game since January
item.description: Josh Giddey had 20 points, 14 rebounds and 10 assists for his eighth triple-double this season, and the Chicago Bulls used a 27-0 run to beat the Milwaukee Bucks 120-97 on Sunday and stop an 11-game losing streak.Giddey had his 15th triple-double as a member of the Bulls, tying Scottie Pippen for second on the franchise list.Collin Sexton added 22 points, and Matas Buzelis had 20, helping Chicago come out on top after matching the third-worst skid in franchise history. item.title: 6 displaced after early morning fire destroys north suburban home, officials say
item.description: A large fire tore through a home in north suburban Lincolnwood early Sunday, displacing six people, officials said.The fire broke out about 12:30 a.m. at a two-story, single-family home in the 6400 block of Komar Avenue.Lincolnwood fire officials said the blaze started in an attached garage and spread through the main overhead garage door and roof before extending into the home.Six people were inside at the time and were able to evacuate safely, officials said. item.title: Man fatally shot on Chicago’s Southwest Side, suspect at large: police
item.description: A 45-year-old man was shot and killed Sunday night on Chicago’s Southwest Side, and the suspect remains at large, authorities said.The shooting occurred just after 8:30 p.m. in the 3900 block of West 62nd Street, according to Chicago police.The man was standing outside when someone shot him once in the head, police said.
